items.section: 3.5 A tunnel observed at its collars
items.sentence: A cochlear membrane's own fatty acid composition stands unpublished.
items.text: Bony otic capsules of female CBA/J mice, each sample one inner ear and each capsule holding the whole cochlea and the vestibular organs together with sensory epithelia, neurons and nerves, give 735 lipids across 26 classes, with fatty acids, acylcarnitines and free carnitine by a targeted method. With 2 hours at 100 decibels, 22 lipid species rise and 39 fall; 3 of 4 very-long-chain polyunsaturated and 5 of 8 long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids fall, 4 of 5 long-chain monounsaturated fall, free carnitine falls, and 5 of 6 long-chain polyunsaturated and 3 of 4 long-chain monounsaturated acylcarnitines rise. With an inhibitor of CPT-1A at 112 decibels, 4 of 4 very-long-chain and 6 of 8 long-chain polyunsaturated and 6 of 6 long-chain monounsaturated fatty acids accumulate, and a chronic dosing of it lowers threshold shifts by up to about 20 decibels. The tissue is a whole otic capsule and not a cochlear membrane, and a β-oxidation is read from the fatty acid and acylcarnitine levels and measured with none of its own.
items.from: Lipids of a whole otic capsule measured with noise and with a CPT-1A inhibitor

leaving.from: Six of twenty-six lipid classes named in series
leaving.why: no lists in nature: six class names of twenty-six, each doing no work elsewhere in the item, leave with the count 26 standing whole and every measured direction standing with its own naming
